baseline_models.focus_anchor: The exception in "لا يسمعون فيها لغوا إلا سلاما" joins hearing, excluded laghw, and admitted salām.
baseline_models.mechanism: Hearing includes receptive understanding, while laghw ranges from disregarded speech to corrupt speech and mixed noise. Salām therefore fills the soundscape with communication that effects safety and reconciliation rather than leaving a merely silent environment.

activation_trace.role: Hearing as understanding and compliance makes the clause regulate received social meaning, not only audible volume.
Speech that is discarded or carries no account supplies the excluded category and makes exclusion qualitative.
Mixed disruptive noise supplies the acoustic edge of laghw and prevents reducing it to false propositions alone.
Freedom from injury gives the admitted utterance a protective result, not merely a polite formula.
Reconciliation against conflict supplies the positive social operation of the speech that remains.

changed_reading.before: The inhabitants hear no idle talk, only greetings.
changed_reading.after: Their auditory-social environment admits no speech without good consequence; what is received as speech actively carries safety and reconciliation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The possessive "رزقهم" is paired with "بكرة وعشيا" inside the repeated "فيها".
baseline_models.mechanism: Rizq is an apportioned gift and sustaining food; early day and late day bracket a recurring experienced interval. The verse thus presents provision as an assured share that gives time a dependable cadence, not as goods acquired under scarcity.

activation_trace.role: An apportioned gift supplies the beneficiaries' already assigned share and removes acquisition from the mechanism.
Food that sustains the body keeps the allotment materially grounded rather than purely abstract.
The opening of the day supplies the first temporal pole and the sense of prompt arrival.
Late day and evening supply the closing temporal pole, turning the pair into a recurring bracket.

changed_reading.before: Food is served at two named meal times.
changed_reading.after: An already apportioned share reliably returns across the full experienced cadence marked by early and late day.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding sequence lets prescribed worship slip, follows craving after craving, and reaches an endpoint whose branches include corrupted livelihood and hunger. Against that chain, the focus makes apportioned provision arrive on a fixed cadence: appetite no longer leads conduct or determines when sustenance is obtained.

activation_trace.role: The assigned gift supplies a provision that precedes demand and anchors the reversal of appetite-led acquisition.
Early-day regularity supplies one fixed boundary of the new provisioning order.
Late-day regularity closes the cadence and makes provision ordered rather than impulsive.
Letting something pass away supplies the initial loss from which the disordered sequence develops.
Specified worship supplies the abandoned temporal practice that contrasts with the focus's restored cadence.
Successive following supplies the directional movement by which conduct is handed over to appetite.
Craving renewed after craving supplies an open-ended appetite cycle opposed by bounded provision.
Hunger and emptiness make the endpoint of deviation touch the focus's provision axis directly.

structural_cues: 19:59 orders loss of worship, successive desire, and encounter with ghayy; 19:62 orders excluded laghw, salām, and possessed provision at paired times.
The focus places provision after an acoustic rule, so both desire and discourse are subordinated to one ordered environment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies abandoned worship, successive cravings, a hunger branch, and timed apportioned provision; I infer a reversal from appetite-led pursuit to provision-led appetite. A live alternative is regular abundance without an implied critique of appetite.

changed_reading.before: Morning and evening simply specify when abundant food appears.
changed_reading.after: The recurring allotment repairs a failed order: desire ceases to drive pursuit, and sustenance instead arrives within a stable cadence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surrounding sequence gives the focus provision a fulfillment structure: a promise has an appointment and comes, the garden is transferred without contract or cost, descent occurs under command, and neglect is negated. "Their provision" becomes a reliably administered allotment inside an inherited promise.

activation_trace.role: The apportioned gift supplies the concrete share whose reliability the context activates.
The opening time supplies one recurring appointment for fulfillment.
The late-day time supplies the matching appointment and completes the delivery cadence.
A promise bounded by time or place supplies the appointment structure behind the focus's paired times.
Actual coming supplies fulfillment rather than a promise left at the level of speech.
Transfer of possession without contract or cost makes the garden and its provision received tenure rather than purchase.
Ordered descent supplies a vertical delivery motion around the focus's recurring allotment.
Binding command supplies governance for descent and makes reliability administered rather than accidental.
The negated image of leaving or neglecting blocks lapse in the fulfillment mechanism.

structural_cues: 19:61 promise and arrival precede the focus; 19:63 inheritance and 19:64 commanded descent without forgetting follow it.
The possessive suffix in "رزقهم" fits a share already assigned to its recipients.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies appointment, arrival, costless transfer, commanded descent, and negated neglect; I infer that these jointly describe the reliability of the focus provision. A live alternative is that descent concerns only messengers while provision remains an independent image.

changed_reading.before: The inhabitants happen to receive recurring food in the garden.
changed_reading.after: Their recurring share is the administered fulfillment of a promise and an inherited grant, with lapse explicitly excluded.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence compels a gathering and arrival, fixes it by binding decree, then separates and rescues the guarded. In that frame salām can be heard as a ratified condition after passage through danger: the only received word in the garden voices actual safety.

activation_trace.role: Reception as understanding lets the heard salām function like an intelligible assurance or verdict.
Freedom from injury supplies the substantive condition announced after danger, beyond a conventional greeting.
Driving and collecting a group toward one destination supplies the compelled convergence before sorting.
Arrival at a thing supplies the threshold that must be reached before safety can be distinguished.
A binding, perfected decree supplies the nonoptional status of the crossing.
Decisive judgment supplies juridical closure to the passage.
Escape by separation supplies the transition from a mixed gathering to the safe population.
Placing oneself under protection identifies the population for whom salām becomes an achieved condition.

structural_cues: 19:68-72 moves from forced gathering and arrival to decree, separation, and rescue; 19:62 locates salām inside the promised destination.
The exception leaves salām as the positive remainder after exclusion, echoing the later separation of populations.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies compelled arrival, binding judgment, rescue, and protection; I infer that salām voices the result of that passage. A live alternative is ordinary resident-to-resident greeting with no verdict-like force.

changed_reading.before: Salām is pleasant speech heard after entry.
changed_reading.after: Salām also carries the achieved status of having crossed danger and been separated into safety; hearing it ratifies the garden's protected condition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later public claim ranks two parties by station and assembly, then expands the comparison through goods, visible display, and supporting host. Those branches give laghw a concrete social mechanism: speech manufactures factional prestige. The focus replaces that circulation with salām and an apportioned share that need not be won by comparison.

activation_trace.role: Public reputation and social circulation make hearing the channel through which status claims would normally spread.
Mixed raised noise supplies the public contest that is removed from the garden's social acoustics.
Reconciliation supplies a noncompetitive relation in place of factional verbal rivalry.
Each group's assigned share removes provision from prestige competition and anchors the social reading materially.
An overt spoken claim supplies the vehicle by which the comparison is made public.
Separated parties supply the factional units whose prestige is being compared.
Station and residence supply a rankable venue used as evidence of superiority.
The social council and gathering supply the audience and institution in which prestige is displayed.
Abundant goods supply the material metric added to the status claim.
Visible appearance and display supply the optical metric paired with material abundance.
A mutually supporting host supplies the final collective metric of worldly standing.

structural_cues: 19:73 embeds a direct comparative utterance between parties and names station and assembly; 19:74-75 extend its measures to goods, appearance, and host.
In 19:62 the auditory rule immediately precedes the statement that provision is already theirs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies public speech, factions, rankable venues, goods, display, and host; I infer that this is a concrete species of the laghw excluded by the focus. A live alternative is that laghw denotes broader futility while the status scene is only an external contrast.

changed_reading.before: Laghw is generic idle or offensive chatter absent from paradise.
changed_reading.after: Laghw includes the public prestige speech that divides people by venue, possessions, appearance, and supporters; salām and assigned provision dismantle that status economy.

context_deltas.mechanism: A recurring appointed share, durable remainder, recompense returning to its worker, and return to a place converge on the focus's early/late pair. This activates morning and evening as markers of assured recurrence within enduring life, without requiring the pair to describe terrestrial astronomy.

activation_trace.role: The apportioned share supplies what recurs and keeps the temporal model tied to provision.
Early day supplies the opening marker of each experienced recurrence.
Late day supplies the complementary closing marker rather than a claim about celestial mechanics.
A recurring appointed portion supplies a branch-level bridge from arrival to repeated allocation.
Endurance supplies the unbroken horizon within which recurrence can continue.
Recompense returning to its worker supplies return as reward rather than mere repetition.
Return to a place or condition supplies the explicit closing motion of the temporal circuit.

structural_cues: The focus pairs two temporal accusatives around one possessed provision; 19:71 and 19:76 later supply appointed recurrence, endurance, recompense, and return.
The two times can mark a complete experienced cadence even where the physical basis of day and night is unstated.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recurrence and return branches around an enduring reward; I infer a non-astronomical cadence for the focus pair. A live alternative is the conventional literal idiom of provision at morning and evening.

changed_reading.before: Morning and evening are two earthly-style clock times.
changed_reading.after: They can be recurrence markers: the allotted gift keeps returning through an enduring, intelligible cadence, whether or not terrestrial day-night mechanics persist.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it assembles object and material senses that are distant from the focus surface forms and several context usages. It remains packet-anchored through an exact cluster of bucket side, one-handled bucket, pulley, alternating drawers, watering machine, hand-drawing, water carrying, and replenished flow. Downstream prose should present it only as a convergent material analogy for recurrent provision, never as the lexical translation of the ayah.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Branches behind the focus words for hearing, salām, provision, and early day unexpectedly supply parts and contents of a water-distribution rig.

activation_trace.role: A bucket side or handle supplies one attachment point of the inferred rig while remaining form-distant from the hearing verb.
A one-handled water bucket supplies the vessel, an exploratory object sense rather than a replacement for salām.
Rain named as provision supplies the life-bearing material moved through the analogy.
A rotating pulley supplies the recurrent mechanical motion and anchors it directly in the focus.
Water drawers taking turns supply alternating human operation of the recurrent mechanism.
A watering machine supplies a second explicit apparatus image that strengthens the material convergence.
Water drawn by hand supplies the extraction action performed by the rig.
The non-dominant mapped root's carrying of water supplies transport, while its distance from the surface comparison keeps the model exploratory.
Flow replenished by further water supplies continuity, turning a single draw into an abundant circuit.

changed_reading.before: The temporal pair indicates recurring meals or gifts.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, recurring provision resembles a replenished water circuit: vessel, handle, pulley, alternating draw, transport, and renewed flow.

strongest_changes: Salām becomes the only socially efficacious heard content, not merely a greeting interrupting silence.
Timed rizq becomes a reliably fulfilled allotment that reverses appetite-led acquisition.
The later status contest makes public comparison a concrete form of laghw displaced by salām and noncompetitive provision.
summary.what_was_special: The exact branch cluster also yielded a contained water-lifting analogy for recurrent provision, with enough convergence to preserve but too much form-distance to lexicalize.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether morning and evening name literal recurring times or a non-astronomical cadence.
Whether salām is resident speech, a verdict of achieved safety, or both coexisting functions.
The water-lifting circuit depends on form-distant branch images and should remain exploratory.
